name: @mapseek/raster-style
description: Raster Style Spec v3 JSON and Q3 query codec

scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const path of ['dist', '.build/test']) rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test .build/test/src/*.test.js test/*.test.mjs
